verdict.rationale: Calendly's first-party pricing page lists what tiers include: a Free 'Always free' tier with one-on-one scheduling and a customizable booking page, plus round-robin, team scheduling, payments and recordings. Per-user-per-month prices ($8 essentials, $16/$20 Teams) appear only in community reports, not in first-party pricing evidence. missing for 10: first-party published per-seat dollar amounts for each tier, an explicit tier-by-tier mapping of features to paid plans, and current independent confirmation of pricing.

support.subject: As a founder, published per-seat pricing tells me exactly what each tier costs and includes before I talk to sales

citations.quote: One-on-one scheduling; Customizable booking page; Browser extension
We pay 16/20 USD (yearly/monthly) per user per month to Calendly
Calendly is $8/user/month for essentials tier and $12/month for professional tier.
